T0547.title: Third-Party App Authorization
T0547.definition: Permission granted to an external application to access enterprise SaaS data, APIs, or account capabilities.
T0547.description: Third-party app authorization opens enterprise SaaS, drive, email, or collaboration-platform data to external applications. Unreviewed grants can persistently bypass interactive login and MFA controls. Governance should include app onboarding, permission review, dormant-grant cleanup, and monitoring of high-risk API calls.
T0547.usageExample: Assess Third-Party App Authorization related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
